player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko Battleship game no.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛsɛn wo pɛnii nyinaa ɛsoro ansa na wɔasɛn wo deɛ.
Wo berɛ mu no, wo tumi tu missiles wɔ coordinates ahodoɔ wɔ format yi: '[a4]'. Sɛ missile no kɔtra ship bi, wɔde 'X' kyerɛ no. Sɛ ɛtumi kɔtra, wɔde 'O' kyerɛ no. Wɔdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ no, game no bɛma wo asem sɛ wo kɔtra. Sɛ wo asɛn prɛko bi, game no bɛka wo!
Game no bɛba awieɛ sɛ wo pɛnii nyinaa asɛn.
Wo board a edi kan no bɛkyerɛ wo pɛnii nyinaa a wo de guu mu ne wo pɛnii a wɔde kɔtra wo, ne wo kɔtra ne wo mmɔneɛ wɔ wo pɛnii board no so a wɔnnye wo pɛnii no.
Yɛn board a edi kan no ni:
